editorial: When you think a pizza delivery is routine, this film flips that assumption into a surreal labyrinth of altered perception. In Pizza Movie, a tight cluster of college friends drifts into a homemade drug trip that morphs dorm lobby stairs into a maze of warped memories. The screen suddenly decodes itself into a shimmering, low‑resolution VHS aesthetic, turning the pizza order into a surreal manifesto on digital disconnect. You will appreciate it if you love psychological thrillers that dance with humor and haunt your thoughts. Only the occasional pacing lag momentarily throws you off, but the film’s daring visuals override that hiccup.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of psychological thrillers who enjoy non-linear storytelling.
similarMovies: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
